headline: RBI: Underwriting auction for ₹33,000 crore G-Secs on October 23, 2026
summary_points: Government of India to re-issue two dated securities worth ₹33,000 crore through auction on October 23, 2026 (Friday).
Underwriting auction uses the multiple price-based method under the underwriting scheme notified on November 14, 2007.
PDs bid for the ACU auction on e-Kuber between 9:00 AM and 9:30 AM on the auction day; commission is credited on the day of issue.

columns: Min. ACU bid per PD (₹ crore)

who_is_affected: Primary Dealers participating in the underwriting of government securities, and treasury teams of banks and institutions tracking G-Sec auctions.
action_required: PDs must submit ACU auction bids on e-Kuber between 9:00 AM and 9:30 AM on October 23, 2026 to meet their minimum bidding commitments.

social.linkedin:
RBI has issued a press release on the underwriting auction for the sale of Government Securities worth ₹33,000 crore, scheduled for October 23, 2026 (Friday).

The Government of India is re-issuing two securities: 6.53% GS 2031 (₹19,000 crore) and 7.71% GS 2066 (₹14,000 crore).

Under the underwriting scheme notified on November 14, 2007, each Primary Dealer has a Minimum Underwriting Commitment and a minimum ACU bidding commitment of ₹453 crore for the 2031 security and ₹334 crore for the 2066 security.

The underwriting auction will follow the multiple price-based method. PDs can bid electronically on RBI's e-Kuber system between 9:00 AM and 9:30 AM on the day. Underwriting commission will be credited to PDs' current accounts with RBI on the day of issue.

Treasury and debt market teams may want to note the timelines.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1366).
